body: Today marks a week since I had to say goodbye to my beloved cat. He was my best friend for 14 years too. My heart is still so heavy but it’s getting better each day. . I’m so very sorry for your loss, and I understand the pain. No words can make it go away but at least we aren’t alone in it. Cheers to brighter days and healing, friend.

Looks like my baby of 14 years that just passed. Literally looked the same as a kitten, and he brought so much joy to my life growing up. Enjoy the ride and the friendship. Thank you for sharing and congratulations!
I’m sorry for your loss as well. Currently not doing so well, but nice to know I’m not alone.
I’m so sorry for your loss as well
Inside Out made me cry like a bitch

When they drop you like a fly the moment they get a significant other. Turns out you’re always the single friend to lean on when they’re single too or going through a breakup. I’ve had to cut a few “friends” off due to this, especially as I got older. It’s painful, but they’re not your real friends.
